purpose:
One mechanical port-velocity reduction experiment, on copied full API sources.

The baseline enables guarded pressure SIMD. Only the candidate's float bridge
port sum reassociates. Independent double-energy audits precede sound/timing.

input_manifest.pressure_baseline: Live guarded pressure SIMD explicitly enabled; current zero-gap controller.

limits: Mechanical reduction order intentionally changes; no byte-parity conservation or inaudibility claim. Independent double energy measures empirical near-passivity of an already approximate float core. No SDK/Reason/multithread qualification; no global fastmath,FMA,OpenMP runtime/worker or canonical adoption.

decision: Retain one research candidate: median throughput improves 5.6–13.2% against explicit experimental pressure-ON control and all predefined physical gates pass. Dense p95 callbacks regress at both rates; no default/canonical adoption, deadline/inaudibility/SDK claim.

peak_analysis_revision.reason: Original ±2bin maximum matcher could jump to a different stronger peak even for identical audio. Replaced with nearest local-maximum matching. An eightfold FFT grid also removes coarse three-bin interpolation bias exposed by a known +1 cent tone test. Original invalid results retained; no DSP/audio/timing rerun.

baseline_scope: Both arms explicitly enable KEYRA_FULL_PRESSURE_SIMD=1 with -fopenmp-simd. Product pressure default is OFF. These are additional chain-specific gains, not a comparison against or combined percentage for the default backend.
unresolved_pressure_repeat_cost: The separate pressure integration has an unexplained 48 kHz repetition regression. This port study does not attribute it to denormals or host noise. Actual SIMD product/partial-accumulator subnormal instrumentation was deferred; no FTZ/DAZ/flush policy change.
vectorization_evidence: GCC reports actual candidate portVelocity body at PreparedModel.h:95:39 vectorized using 16-byte vectors; line 94 reduction setup is recorded separately. Displacement/contact expressions unchanged. Private candidate has guarded scalar fallback with original expression; SDK/compiler behavior untested.

source_freeze.input_guard_scope: Verified live inputs through completion, then all ten inputs snapshotted before releasing the API agent to make later source changes.
